headline: Germany is paying for tens of thousands of interceptor drones, built in Ukraine, to shoot down Russian attack drones.
score_reason: Large government-funded drone order with a war-time use; single outlet and no exact quantity.
importance_line: Ukrainian city residents gain more defence against drone attacks and Quantum Systems gains a large order, but the exact number and delivery dates are not stated.
summary: Trending Topics reports that Chancellor Friedrich Merz announced, during a surprise visit to Kyiv, that Germany will pay for several tens of thousands of interceptor drones from Munich defence start-up Quantum Systems, to be built in Ukraine as part of its 2026/2027 winter aid. Interceptors are small drones that hunt down enemy drones; the order matters because Russia is reported to be using faster, jet-powered Shahed models, though no exact order size or delivery date is given.
notes: Euronews credited by the article for the 1 bn and 350 m euro pledges; not independently checked.
